origin.description: Locate every literal match in each string.
origin.usage: stri_locate_all_fixed(str, pattern, omit_no_match = FALSE, get_length = FALSE, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If TRUE, no match is a matrix with zero rows instead of one NA row.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If TRUE, the second column is the match length and a miss is -1.

origin.details: Each list element is an integer matrix with columns start and end. Indexes are 1-based inclusive code points. A missing string or an empty pattern is one NA row even when omit_no_match is TRUE. An empty string uses -1 only when get_length is TRUE. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: A list of integer matrices with columns start and end, or start and length.
origin.example:
loc <- stri_locate_all_fixed("abababa", "ABA", case_insensitive = TRUE, overlap = TRUE)[[1]]
cat(paste0('stri_locate_all_fixed("abababa", "ABA", case_insensitive=TRUE, overlap=TRUE) finds starts ', paste(loc[, 1], collapse = ", "), '.\n'))

translation.description: Locate every literal match in each string.
translation.usage: stri_locate_all_fixed(str, pattern, omit_no_match=False, get_length=False, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If true, no match is a matrix with zero rows instead of one NA row.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If true, the second column is the match length and a miss is -1.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is honored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: If true, matches may share code points.

translation.details: Each list element is a matrix of rows start, end. Indexes are 1-based inclusive code points. A missing string or an empty pattern is one NA row even when omit_no_match is true. An empty string uses -1 only when get_length is true. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of matrices. Each matrix is a list of start, end rows, or start, length rows.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_locate_all_fixed
loc = stri_locate_all_fixed("abababa", "ABA", case_insensitive=True, overlap=True)[0]
starts = ", ".join(str(row[0]) for row in loc)
print('stri_locate_all_fixed("abababa", "ABA", case_insensitive=True, overlap=True) finds starts ' + starts + ".")
